name: Injoku Kissa
source:
Main character is a family restaurant manager. He invents a plan to insult two co-workers - a clumsy girl and an elegant woman. Will he succeed?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一家家庭餐厅的经理。他设计了一个计划，打算羞辱两名同事——一个笨拙的女孩和一个优雅的女人。他能成功吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
